sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_packages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "size" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("barcode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "markets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_observations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "market_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "package_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_packages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "regular_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "condition_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'anyCustomer', "minimum_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_items" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "minimum_quantity" REAL NULL, "location" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "package_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_packages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "since" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "delta" REAL NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checked_at" INTEGER NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_trips" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "market_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cart_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "package_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_packages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "price_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("price_estimated" IN (0, 1)), "take" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("take" IN (0, 1)), "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "market_aisles" ("market_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "aisle" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" REAL NOT NULL, "samples" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("market_id", "aisle"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scale_items" ("market_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("market_id", "item_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_prices" ("trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "package_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_packages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "other_offers" TEXT NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "observation_id" TEXT NULL, "per_kilo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("per_kilo" IN (0, 1)), "market_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trip_id", "item_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "remembered_locations" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "location" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));
CREATE INDEX price_observations_product_date ON price_observations (product_id, observed_at)
